CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 4, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 6:59 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

  Commissioner Mojarro arrived at 7:00 P.M.

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner; Vanessa Norwood, Contract Senior Planner;
  Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – February 5, 2024 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the February 5, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the February 5, 2024, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Tsujii.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-3-0
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Bryden, Gardea, Pham
  Absent: None

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-23 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 2415 Whitney Drive
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-23 to allow a 530 square foot second-
  story addition to an existing single-family dwelling as well as the
  construction of a 400 square foot detached garage located in the 2400
  South Fremont Avenue Specific Plan (SP) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 24-02 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-23 subject to the Conditions of Approval,
  and finding Planned Development Permit PD-21-23 to be exempt
  from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  existing facilities.
  • Contract Senior Planner Vanessa Norwood provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • Benjuro Thomas and Tung & Ming Ho, the Applicant and property
  owners, respectively, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Russ Bryden

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with an added condition of approval requiring: 1.) The
  Applicant shall maintain the existing 2’ retaining wall and can add a 3’
  fence on top of the existing retaining wall.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  2
  03/04/2024
   Roll Call Vote: 6-3-1-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro
  Recused: Bryden
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-30 (7:38 P.M.)
  • 36 & 40 West Bay State Street
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Conditional
  Use Permit CUP-23-30 to allow a Buddhist cultural worship hall,
  religious teaching center, and related offices, located within two (2)
  existing commercial buildings with a combined floor area of
  approximately 5,658 square feet located in the CBD (Central Business
  District) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Continue the public hearing to the next
  regular meeting of the Planning Commission on Monday, March 18,
  2024 at 7:00 P.M.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain None
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 4: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-58, CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-23-24, AND LOT MERGER LOTM-23-07 (7:39
  P.M.)
  • 1303, 1325, and 1345 West Main Street
  • Request: This is a public hearing for an application for a Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-58, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-24,
  and Lot Merger LOTM-23-07 to construct and operate a two-story,
  19,771 square foot automotive dealership and to merge three (3)
  parcels into one (1) parcel on an approximate 1.04-acre site located in
  the CPD (Commercial Planned Development) zone and AC
  (Automobile Commercial) Overlay District.
  • Recommended Action: Continue the public hearing to the next
  regular meeting of the Planning Commission on Monday, March 18,
  2024 at 7:00 P.M.

  3
  03/04/2024
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
